arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2P5D.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CUSTOMER-ID           PIC X(12).
       01  WS-UPDATE-RECEIVED       PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-UPLOAD-STATUS         PIC X(8) VALUE 'PENDING'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-CUSTOMER-ID
           ACCEPT WS-UPDATE-RECEIVED
           IF WS-UPDATE-RECEIVED = 'Y'
              CALL 'T6V2UPLD' USING WS-CUSTOMER-ID
                                    WS-UPLOAD-STATUS
           END-IF
           DISPLAY WS-UPLOAD-STATUS
           STOP RUN.
       END PROGRAM T6V2P5D.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2UPLD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  LK-CUSTOMER-ID           PIC X(12).
       01  LK-UPLOAD-STATUS         PIC X(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LK-CUSTOMER-ID LK-UPLOAD-STATUS.
       2000-UPLOAD-RECORD.
           IF LK-CUSTOMER-ID NOT = SPACES
              MOVE 'UPLOADED' TO LK-UPLOAD-STATUS
           END-IF
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM T6V2UPLD.
